sentences.text: Intan menganggap lukisan sawah saat musim panen itu sebagai mahakarya kakek.
sentences.en: Intan considers that painting of rice fields at harvest time her grandfather's masterpiece.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 수확철 논을 그린 그 그림을 할아버지의 걸작으로 여겨요.

sentences.text: "Wah, waduh, tenggatnya dimajukan," keluh Bayu.
sentences.en: "Oh no, the deadline's been moved up," Bayu groaned.
sentences.ko: "아이고, 마감이 당겨졌네." 바유가 투덜댔어요.

sentences.text: "Lho, waduh, hujan lagi," gumam Intan sambil mengangkat jemuran.
sentences.en: "Oh no, it's raining again," Intan muttered as she took in the laundry.
sentences.ko: "어머, 또 비 오네." 인탄이 빨래를 걷으며 중얼거렸어요.
